content: <p>📍 Madrid&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>We are looking for an Operations Intern who is eager to gain hands-on experience in People Operations (HR) while being exposed to how a business expands physically.</p> <p>This internship is designed as a learning experience, ideal for students who want to develop practical skills in a dynamic, international environment and be part of building something from the ground up.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What you'll learn &amp; Support</strong></p> <h4 style="color: #0056d2;">People Operations (HR exposure)</h4> <ul> <li>Support onboarding and administrative processes for new hires</li> <li>Assist with employee documentation (contracts, amendments) and payroll checks</li> <li>Maintain and update data across HR and finance systems</li> <li>Act as a support point of contact for employees and internal stakeholders</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h4 style="color: #0056d2;">Operations &amp; Expansion exposure</h4> <ul> <li>Support the team in the process of opening new study centers</li> <li>Assist in coordinating facilities, vendors, and basic operational needs</li> <li>Help ensure smooth communication between internal teams and external partners</li> <li>Contribute to ongoing projects related to study center development</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h4 style="color: #0056d2;">Cross-functional collaboration</h4> <ul> <li>Work closely with People Operations (HR) and RevOps / Expansion teams</li> <li>Learn how operational and people-related decisions support business growth</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Who this internship is for</strong></p> <ul> <li>Students currently enrolled in Business Administration (ADE), Psychology, HR, or related fields</li> <li>Looking to build a career in Peo

<p><strong>Location:</strong> Vienna (Hybrid) &nbsp;|&nbsp; <strong>Reports to:</strong> Head of People Operations &nbsp;|&nbsp; <strong>Scope:</strong> Austria &amp; Germany, multiple legal entities</p> <h3>&nbsp;</h3> <h3><strong>The role in a snapshot</strong></h3> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Love making things work better - and making work better for people? Then let’s talk.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>We are a tech-first scale-up, and our People Operations team runs like one. As People Operations Manager DACH, you will own HR operations for Austria and Germany across multiple legal entities. You are the go-to person for employees and managers and the one who keeps contracts, payroll inputs and policies spot-on. Beyond the day-to-day, we are excited to see you implement your own ideas for automation and improvements, or join existing initiatives we run to streamline our day-to-day and drive operational excellence. You will team up with our Head of People Operations, our People Systems &amp; Payroll Specialist and P&amp;O colleagues across all our markets.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>Employee relations &amp; compliance</strong></h3> <p>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Be the trusted voice on employee relations and labour-law compliance in Austria and Germany across multiple legal entities, pulling in internal and external legal counsel when it counts.</li> <li>Be the first stop for P&amp;O questions from employees and managers across our Austrian and German entities - with answers people actually understand.</li> <li>Coach managers on P&amp;O policies and procedures, so doing the right thing becomes the easy thing.</li> <li>Bring group P&amp;O policies to life locally, create DACH-specific ones where needed, and be our partner to the Works Council.</li> <li>Be the DACH point of contact for internal and external audit</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;&
